moment.text: The plum accompanies their squawking forms; Its fragrance assaults their feathers. Beautiful shadows of the branches in the moonlight Climb toward the study curtain.

matters.text: To this the painter replied that the sum named was not intended for the value of the bird represented, which everybody knew could be bought for a few sen, but that it was a very small part of the cost of the fifty years of study and practice which had enabled him to dash off the life-like painting in this manner.
